versions.changelog:
Initial release of the design-system-audit skill.

- Audits design systems for consistency, coverage, and quality across components, tokens, documentation, accessibility, and adoption.
- Generates a structured audit report with a health score, detailed gap analysis, token and accessibility checks, and prioritized remediation roadmap.
- Outlines required user inputs for effective audits, including team, scope, tooling, and audit goals.
- Provides clear templates and tables for reporting on component inventory, quality assessment, token usage, documentation, accessibility compliance, and adoption barriers.
- Designed to support design system teams, leadership, and engineering stakeholders.
